params.prompt: Smooth high-end 3D still life on a dark warm matte surface (#0B0907), square 1:1, top-down slightly angled view. Scattered evenly across the lower 60% of the frame: a ceramic coffee cup, barber scissors, a chrome wrench, a small paper shopping bag, a dental mirror, a flower pot, a house key, a sneaker — everyday objects of small local businesses. Matte and metal materials, soft warm rim light, one subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow. The upper 40% is empty dark space with vignette for typography. No text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no people. Calm, premium, low contrast.
